defect_pages.summary: Neither Fenix nor Moss appears. The left character is a clothed, front-facing cat-like animal with a ringed striped tail, not the side-view fox with a white-tipped bushy tail, and there is no turtle. A bear, a species outside the book's cast, sits on the log reading a red book.
There are three owls instead of one: Orin on the branch plus two extra small owl-like characters on the ground. Fenix the fox and Moss the turtle do not appear anywhere on the page.

Fenix is present, so the missing-character claim is a false alarm. However, he is off-model: he wears a blue scarf, yellow dress, white apron, orange gloves and brown boots, and is drawn in three-quarter view with two eyes, all contrary to the 'no clothes, no accessories, side view' spec.
Fenix the fox is clearly present, so the missing-character claim is wrong. However, the sheet specifies no clothes or accessories, and here Fenix wears a green shirt and an orange scarf.
Fenix the fox does not appear; a human girl in a red dress stands in that place. Moss's notebook, which should be blank, has numbers ('12, 3, 4, 3, 4') drawn on it.
The word '"Fern', with a stray quotation mark, is painted in green lettering into the sky at the top of the artwork.
Orin is duplicated: six near-identical brown owls with rolled maps appear on the page instead of the single expected owl. No clear anatomy defects are visible; wings and feet look normal on all owls.

Moss, the green turtle, appears five times on the page: sitting at top left, standing front-facing at top right, standing three-quarter in the center, standing in profile at bottom left, and seen from behind at bottom right. The scene calls for only one turtle.

Moss is cloned: five separate turtles appear on the page (top-left sitting, center-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right seen from behind), but the scene should have only one. No broken anatomy is visible on the fox or the turtles.
Two foxes appear on the page: a large red fox in the center-left and a second, smaller fox at lower right. Only Fenix is expected in this scene.

Three foxes appear in the scene (one standing at the table and two seated in chairs) where only Fenix should appear. The foxes are also off-model: they wear a dress and sneakers, while Fenix should have no clothes or accessories.

Neither Fenix the fox nor Moss the turtle appears. Instead the page shows animals from outside the cast: a clothed brown bear/dog-like character standing upright, a small tan puppy, and an orange dog with a red collar and curled tail.
The page shows a human girl with braids writing in a notebook on a rock instead of the expected cast; neither Fenix the fox nor Moss the turtle appears.

Moss the turtle appears three times on the page: once beside Fenix and twice more in the lower half, in side and back views like a turnaround sheet. The limbs and feet of all characters look anatomically normal.
Orin the owl is clearly present on the branch, so the missing-character claim is a false alarm. However, Orin is missing his rolled-up map, which should be tucked under one wing.

Fenix the fox does not appear anywhere on the page; the art shows only a moonlit forest path, trees, bushes and a fern with rocks. With no character present, there is no anatomy to be broken, so the anatomy claim is a false alarm.

Neither Fenix the fox nor Moss the turtle appears on the page. Instead it shows a furry green bear-like creature knocking at the door and a small brown bear cub, neither of which is a species in the book's cast.
Neither Fenix the fox nor Moss the turtle appears on the page. Instead, two human children are drawn holding a map in a forest clearing.
